contentAlert.description: A note above the whole table, for a caveat about the numbers. Takes an element, so it can hold a link.

itemAlign.description: Which side of its column each value sits on. Right lines numbers up with each other.

showSectionHeader.description: Whether section labels are drawn. False hides all of them; the dividers between sections stay.

data.description: The sections, drawn in order and separated by dividers. A section's label heads it, its dataRows fill it, and disabled greys the whole block.
data.type: { label?: string; dataRows: { label: string; value: string | number; }[]; disabled?: boolean; }[]
